author: y. r. grover
title: Rep. Russ Fulcher introduces SILVER Act and honors Idaho agriculture
text:
U.S. Representative Russ Fulcher, who serves Idaho’s 1st district, announced the introduction of the SILVER Act and recognized the role of agriculture in Idaho through a series of posts on his official social media account.
On March 23, 2026, Fulcher wrote, “I’m proud to introduce the SILVER Act. Having metal depositories located in more than one region in the U.S. will provide Americans across the country with affordable access to metal exchanges and safeguard assets in the event of a national emergency or extreme weather event.” In a subsequent post on the same day, he encouraged readers to learn more about H.R. 8007 by stating, “Learn more about H.R. 8007 at the link below. https://t.co/DWhyvGT885”
The following day, Fulcher addressed Idaho’s agricultural community by posting, “Agriculture is deeply ingrained in Idaho’s way of life and culture. Today, we recognize the dedication of the farmers and ranchers who feed, fuel, and power our great nation. Your stewardship is the backbone of our state—and America’s—success. https://t.co/3KzfBuN6pp” on March 24, 2026.
Fulcher has represented Idaho’s 1st district in Congress since 2019 after succeeding Raúl Labrador. Before joining Congress, he served in the Idaho Senate from 2005 to 2014. Born in Boise in 1962 and currently residing in Meridian, Fulcher holds two degrees from Boise State University.
